title: Learn-then-escalate: chronological run from first dodge to top-speed crash

clips.why: Immediate lane-switch dodge and coin pickup without slow tutorial text
Builds speed toward full-width orange barriers
Introduces jump mechanic over barriers with GREAT JUMP! feedback
Obstacle crash followed by Free Revive tap to resume the run
Escalating speed up to 76 with rapid lane switches and coin collection
Peak-speed crash at 246m triggering the Game Over climax
End card displaying 21 coins collected and PLAY NOW tap
